title: P18 adversarial, security, privacy, and performance qualification
objective: Qualify the complete P18 implementation surface adversarially without adding features: build a traceability matrix from requirement to implementation to tests to CI to review to evidence, and prove browser and network mediation, browser identities, transfers, exact-window capture, structured UIA, coordinate input, model adapters, remote lease isolation, failure semantics, resource ceilings, privacy, and denied authority hold under hostile, stale, replay, drift, and overflow conditions.

include: traceability matrix covering every P18 capability from requirement through evidence
adversarial tests for browser and network mediation, identities, transfers, capture, UIA, coordinate input, model adapters, remote isolation, and failure semantics
explicit numeric server-owned hard ceilings for all applicable resources
privacy proof for screenshots, browser content, secrets, credential fields, and protected surfaces
static plus runtime proof that explicitly denied authority remains unreachable

invariants: exposed plus unverified blocks P18 closure

acceptance.claim: Every P18 capability is traced from requirement to implementation to tests to CI to review to evidence, with explicit PROVEN, NOT_EXPOSED, or UNVERIFIED classification and no exposed UNVERIFIED row.

Adversarial, stale, replay, drift, overflow, and confusion tests prove fail-closed behavior across browser, identity, transfer, capture, UIA, coordinate, adapter, remote, and failure-semantics surfaces, with privacy and ceiling proofs.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000086: SG-000086 may activate only after SG-000085 closes canonically with the full P18 qualification matrix as its base.

done_when: The P18 surface is fully qualified adversarially with a complete evidence matrix and no exposed unverified capability.
